description: CSUTLDTC, the called date-validation subprogram, invoked as the @Service it became. LS-DATE='2022-06-31' and LS-DATE-FORMAT='YYYY-MM-DD' are this case's two LINKAGE SECTION parameters (L84-L85); LS-RESULT PIC X(80) (L86) is the output and is asserted below as the single WS_MESSAGE_80 line. This program opens no file and is reached by no JCL, so it seeds no dataset, writes no record and takes no job parameter - its entire observable behaviour is the 80 bytes L97 moves into LS-RESULT and the severity L98 moves into RETURN-CODE. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED from the 01 WS-MESSAGE declaration at L42-L57 and the group move at L122, never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible here. Arm 3 by a second route: 31 June, a day-of-month overflow in a 30-day month rather than a leap-year question. Taken together with case07 this drives both sides of the month-length lookup - the February branch and the short-month branch - which a single case could not.
